description: Alternative-explanation evidence for a candidate long-range haplotype block: track-overlap percentages (tandem repeat, higher-order repeat, segmental duplication, gene, ncRNA), depth / CNV diagnostics, mappability risk, local-PCA cluster diagnostics, and proximity to a centromere candidate. These are measurements only and do not call a class — they are the inputs consumed by block_classification. A block scoring high on TR / HOR / SD / CNV overlap or low mappability may still be a real long-range haplotype but should not be presented as a 'clean inversion' on local-PCA evidence alone (cf. INVERSION_REGISTRY_SPECIFICATION_v2 Q7 layers). Atlas 2.0 extension: generalises the candidate model from 'inversion-only' to 'long-range haplotype block, mechanism to be determined'.
question: Q7
source_script: TBD (to be implemented). Consumes a block interval set (existence_layer_a.block_id intervals) and per-track annotations: TR (TRF / dustmasker), HOR (satellite-array annotation), SD (BISER2 catalog or equivalent), gene / ncRNA (GFF), mappability / MQ0 BED, per-window depth BED, centromere-candidate intervals.

block_id.description: Candidate block / regime identifier. Matches existence_layer_a.block_id so this evidence joins to the local-PCA layer.

tr_overlap_pct.description: Fraction of the block (in bp) covered by tandem-repeat annotations, 0-100. A simple tandem repeat is one repeat unit tiled head-to-tail (A A A A A).

hor_overlap_pct.description: Fraction covered by higher-order-repeat / satellite-array annotations. HOR = blocks of *different* repeat units forming a periodic super-structure (A-B-C-D / A-B-C-D / A-B-C-D), distinct from a plain tandem repeat. Even a rough HOR annotation is informative — the relevant question is whether the block overlaps structured satellite arrays that could explain cluster multiplicity.

sd_overlap_pct.description: Fraction covered by segmental-duplication / paralogous-region annotations (BISER2 catalog or equivalent). High SD overlap raises a NAHR mechanism prior.

gene_overlap_pct.description: Fraction covered by gene annotations (any feature class).

ncrna_overlap_pct.description: Fraction covered by ncRNA / regulatory-RNA annotations; flags repeat-associated RNA content.

mean_depth_ratio.description: Mean per-sample read depth inside the block divided by the cohort-wide median depth. Values markedly below 1 suggest mapping collapse / unique-mapper loss; values markedly above 1 suggest collapsed paralogous mapping or CNV gain.

low_mappability_pct.description: Fraction of the block flagged as low-mappability or MQ0-enriched. High values raise ART_RISK regardless of other signals.

centromere_candidate_distance_bp.description: Distance in bp from the block to the nearest centromere / pericentromere candidate; 0 if overlapping. Small distances raise the CEN_PERI_ASSOCIATED prior.

n_localpca_clusters.description: Number of sample clusters detected by local-PCA inside the block. 3 is consistent with a clean biallelic inversion (HOM1 / HET / HOM2). >3 suggests a repeat-architecture haplotype system where individuals can differ in copy number, unit sequence, or array organisation. 1 indicates no detectable structure.

cluster_FST_like.description: FST-like between-cluster differentiation summary computed over the local-PCA cluster labels in the block. Named '_like' because the partitioning is by inferred clusters rather than declared populations; this is not a population-genetic FST estimator (cf. arrangement_FST_like elsewhere in this registry).

HWE_FIS_pattern.description: Pattern of per-site HWE_FIS deviations within the block. 'balanced_three_class' = HOM / HET / HOM proportions consistent with a single biallelic segregating arrangement (inversion-like). Other patterns may indicate CNV, mapping collapse, or absence of real structure. Uses HWE_FIS rather than bare HWE because the pattern is summarised at the inbreeding-coefficient level.
